run_gtest_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_behavior: test that passing a help flag prints the help message and skips test execution
test_non_help_flag_behavior: test that passing no help flag runs tests and does not print the help message
test_help_with_various_flags: test help output with full flag, short flag, question mark, and Windows-style flags
review_GTestHelpTest_class: review the GTestHelpTest class that verifies Google Test help flag behavior across platforms
